verdict.rationale: Vue is documented as a reactive framework for building web UIs (vue-docs-1, vue-docs-4). Hands-on users praise its ergonomic API for component-level state (vue-comm-2) and its single-file components that encapsulate a component's HTML, JS and styles (vue-comm-8). Some users find it harder for complex apps or report confusion about where state lives (vue-comm-7, vue-comm-18, vue-comm-20), but these are opinions rather than concrete failures, so they lower confidence instead of creating a dispute. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the component model, local state and component composition (the pack's doc items are only taglines and page titles), and concrete evidence of composing components into large, complex UIs.
